title: Mixed7 Duo #20 (임산부+금박)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each from a different Living Artifact track.

#1 (Pregnant track): French, in her late 20s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, and continuing that same broad, continuous, solid silhouette, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward from her thick sturdy torso with no sharp transition anywhere, enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it. Thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair skin, a classic matte red lip, subtle winged eyeliner, curly hair, real pores, ears bare, no piercings, wearing two to three pieces of rose-gold a ring. Painted in Finnish Iittala glass-inspired linework, a deep indigo ground with bold cream concentric ripple-line motifs, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle, wide cream bands curving fully around her belly, the densest concentration of concentric ripple linework wrapping the belly as centrepiece and continuing over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, extreme cream extreme platform clear heels.

#2 (Gold Leaf track): THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, wide hip narrow physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — hips so impossibly wide extending beyond frame creating the most extreme hip-to-waist ratio ever, waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, upper body slim emphasizing the dramatic hip explosion, silver-white natural hair swept into a high sculpted crown — full body applied ELECTRIC VIOLET leaf covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE. Thin irregular metallic sheets — BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET leaf with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID CYAN undertone glinting through the thinnest points, a soft warm metallic sheen filling every gap, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Pose: full frontal wide stance, both fists pressing outer hips outward to absolute maximum — most extreme wide hip narrow silhouette ever displayed. Footwear: platform boots 8 inch, extra long stiletto nails to match.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all bodypaint/pregnant/irezumi/stained-glass/gold-leaf/botanical women from one side, realistic photographic grain where applicable, extreme high-gloss oil on maximalist tracks — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render; any UV Neon track woman additionally lit by her own dedicated UV blacklight spot. Pattern density maximum on all 2, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio.
